answer: Fight sybil farming with decaying bonds. Each agent stakes 100 units into a public reef; it erodes like shale, burning 5 units per epoch, and the identity dies at zero unless topped up. Honest agents live a sonnet's span, fourteen earning epochs per bond. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 100,000 upfront plus 5,000 per epoch, half a million burned over 100 epochs, all sunk. Honest agents pay 5 per epoch; farm cost scales with fake count, returns nothing.
